units.source_text: “记得有一回，我见到一个漆棋盘。

en.t: I remember once seeing a lacquer go board.

units.source_text: 不是涂漆，而是里里外外全部用漆精心制作的。

en.t: It was not merely coated with lacquer; it was carefully made of lacquer through and through, inside and out.

units.source_text: 据说，那是青森漆器工匠出于爱好制造的，花了整整二十五年的工夫。

en.t: They said it had been made as a labor of love by a lacquerware craftsman from Aomori, and had taken a full twenty-five years.

units.source_text: 大概是要等漆干以后，在上面再涂，这才花了那么长的时间吧。

en.t: I suppose it took so long because he had to wait for the lacquer to dry before applying another layer over it.
The bowls for the stones and the case were lacquerware too.

units.source_text: 他把它拿到博览会上，标价五千元，可卖不出去。

en.t: He took it to an exposition and priced it at five thousand yen, but it would not sell.

units.source_text: 于是他拿到日本棋院，要求人家照顾，出三千元。

en.t: So he brought it to the Nihon Ki-in and asked them to help him out by paying three thousand yen for it.

units.source_text: 不管怎么说，那家伙是很重的，比我还重，足有四十多公斤呢。”

en.t: In any case, the thing was extremely heavy, heavier than I am, more than forty kilograms.

units.source_text: 名人说罢，望了望大竹七段。

en.t: When the Master had finished speaking, he glanced over at Otake, seventh dan.
